This removes the stored session cookies, cached usage and widget data from this device.

Gemini Quota is an unofficial, personal-use app. It is not affiliated with Google.

• Usage is read from the signed-in Gemini web session (gemini.google.com/usage) because Google does not publish a public API for subscription limits.
• The session cookie is stored encrypted with a key held in the Android Keystore and is only sent to gemini.google.com.
• Usage data and the session never leave this device. There is no analytics or tracking.
• Gemini limits are compute-based: the app shows the percentage used and when each window resets, not a count of remaining prompts.
• Google can change or block these endpoints at any time; the widget will then report that it needs a new sign-in or that the response format changed.

Use at your own risk and in line with Google's terms of service.
